settings.heading: From us to your door
settings.text: Everything about getting your order, and what to do if something isn't right.

settings.heading: Delivery
settings.note: Question about a delivery? Email us or use the contact form.

settings.label: Cost
settings.value: Rs 100 per order, and free when your order is over Rs 1,500.

settings.label: When
settings.value: Usually 1 to 3 working days after your order is confirmed.

settings.label: Collection
settings.value: In Mon Gout, by arrangement. Email us and we'll find a time.

settings.label: Unopened
settings.value: Unopened products in their original packaging can come back within seven days of delivery. Send us your order number and the reason, and we'll sort it.

settings.label: Opened
settings.value: Opened skincare can't be returned for hygiene reasons, unless it's faulty or not what you ordered.

settings.label: Refunds
settings.value: Once it's back with us and checked, we refund the card you paid with.
